name: flow-2039-long-ai
notes: flow-2039-long with the Resistance handed to the game's AI on day 0 (ai.control; user, 2026-10-22). Compare with flow-2039-long (passive Resistance): does an AI-run defender use the strike's ~198-day flight to reinforce Jupiter, and does the strike still win?
asserts: max([e['have'] / e['need'] for e in events('pool', targetSystem='Jupiter') if e['need'] > 0] or [0]) >= 0.8

[f['contempt'] for f in events('disposition')[-1]['factions'] if f['faction'] == 'ResistCouncil'][0] <= [f['contempt'] for f in events('disposition', ev='initial')[0]['factions'] if f['faction'] == 'ResistCouncil'][0] - 0.08

sum(faction(last, f).get('scv', 0) for f in ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil']) >= 1.1 * sum(faction(first, f).get('scv', 0) for f in ['DestroyCouncil','CooperateCouncil','ExploitCouncil','EscapeCouncil','SubmitCouncil','AppeaseCouncil'])
info: events('control')
[(e['t'], e.get('ev'), e.get('system'), round(e.get('threat', 0)), round(e.get('defence', 0)), e.get('firstArrival'), e.get('sent')) for e in events('bot')]
[(e['t'], e['order'], e['ok'], e['why'], e['fleet'], e.get('to') or e.get('into'), e.get('arrive')) for e in events('order')][:30]
(count('order', order='move', ok=True), count('order', order='merge', ok=True), count('order', ok=False))

[(r['t'][:7], r['fleet'], r['ships'], round(r['scv']), r['toBody'], (r.get('flight') or {}).get('arrive'), (r.get('flight') or {}).get('flightDays')) for r in events('transfer', goal='AttackWithFleet', toSystem='Jupiter')]
[(r['t'][:7], round(faction(r, 'ResistCouncil').get('scvBySystem', {}).get('Jupiter', 0)), faction(r, 'ResistCouncil').get('habsBySystem', {}).get('Jupiter', 0)) for r in metrics]
[(e['t'], e['body'], e.get('attacker'), e.get('winner'), [(s['f'], round(s['fleetScv0']), s['destroyed'], s['fled'], s['assets']) for s in e['sides']]) for e in events('combat', system='Jupiter')]
(count('combat', system='Jupiter', winner='AlienCouncil'), count('combat', system='Jupiter'))
[(e['t'], e['faction'], e.get('habType'), e['body']) for e in events('hab-') if e['body'] in ('Io', 'Europa', 'Ganymede', 'Callisto', 'Amalthea', 'Himalia', 'Jupiter')]

(faction(first, 'ResistCouncil').get('habsBySystem', {}).get('Jupiter', 0), faction(last, 'ResistCouncil').get('habsBySystem', {}).get('Jupiter', 0))
